subject: Auxiliary credits for throughput smoke test — Atlas Retail POC
messages:
From: Daniel Moss <daniel.moss@atlasretail.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlasretail.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional credits for throughput smoke tests

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model latency looked promising. We want to run a short, higher-concurrency smoke run next week to validate end-to-end throughput (including our proxy and your prefix caching behavior). Can Redwood provide an auxiliary credit top-up for a 48-hour window?

Estimate: roughly 2.5M tokens over 48 hours (peak concurrency ~120 qps sustained for 90 minutes, then step down). We can share the load plan and a small sample network trace.

Required by: Sep 15th (we'd like to schedule the run on Sep 16).

Thanks,
Daniel Moss
Senior Engineering Manager, Atlas Retail
Attachment: atlas-poc-load-snapshot.csv (CSV, 8KB)
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Moss <daniel.moss@atlasretail.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: additional credits for throughput smoke tests

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the details and the timing. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in the approvals team:
- Can you confirm the token estimate (2.5M) is total across the whole 48h window or the peak 90-minute segment?
- Will the run originate from a single region (us-west) or multiple regions?

If it's the smaller-scope single-region 48h window we generally can approve a short-term top-up. I can get a provisional allocation from sales operations once Ben and Security OK the pattern (network trace helps).

Please attach the load plan and a sample trace; I attached a short template our ops team prefers.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Build inference that scales
Attachment stub: redwood-load-plan-template.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: additional credits for throughput smoke tests

Ben / Neha — forwarding a request from Atlas Retail. They want a short 48-hour auxiliary credit top-up to validate throughput (2.5M tokens estimate). Run scheduled Sep 16 if approved.

Why I'm asking: this is a time-boxed POC run to validate latency/throughput with known load patterns; no production data retention beyond short logs. Typical ask: provide an ephemeral credit bucket or trial top-up tied to DL-2026-0897.

Questions for approvals:
- Ben: can ops allocate a short-term credit bucket and tag it to the account? Any limits we should enforce (max tokens, qps caps)?
- Neha: any security or data-retention concerns with their test harness (they said proxy + sample traces)? If you need the network trace I can share it.

I attached their load plan and the trace they sent.

Thanks,
Maya
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: additional credits for throughput smoke tests

Maya —

OK to allocate an auxiliary 3,000,000-token bucket for a 72-hour window (to give a little buffer). Tag to DL-2026-0897; enforce a hard qps cap of 150 and rate-limit fallback to 60 if we detect sustained errors. Operational notes: we'll provision in us-west only.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, procurement@atlasretail.com

Hi Daniel —

Good news: we have provisional approval. Details below and next steps:

What we allocated
- Auxiliary credit: 3,000,000 token bucket (ephemeral)
- Window: 72 hours starting when you tell us to enable (we recommend starting on Sep 16 00:00 UTC if that works)
- Region: us-west (single region)
- Operational caps: qps hard cap 150, automatic fallback to 60 on error spike

What we need from you
1) Confirm start time (reply-all)
2) Sign the short POC addendum (DocuSign link below) — this just formalizes the ephemeral allocation and confirms no additional billing beyond the top-up during the window
3) Share the final load plan and any additional traces (attach to this thread)

Links & artifacts
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/98765
- POC load plan (we've appended their file and our template): poc-load-plan.xlsx
- DocuSign: https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC-1234

Attachments: poc-load-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 46KB); network-trace-sample.txt (TXT, 18KB)

If that all looks good I'll flip the toggle once we receive the signed addendum and your confirmed start time.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
